model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for the MistralV0.2-Base model, fine-tuned on various medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, labeled “Cardio”, “Gastro”, “Infect”, “Neuro”, “Obstetrics”, and “Pediatrics”, appearing in that order, with evenly spaced tick labels. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability”, represents a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick labels at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are two bars displayed side-by-side. The bars are colored orange and light blue, corresponding to the labels “MistralV0.2-Base” and “Fine-tuned on” respectively, as indicated by the legend. The height of the bars varies by specialty; the shortest bars are found for “Cardio” and "Gastro” at approximately -22, whereas the tallest bars appear for “Neuro” and “Pediatrics”, reaching about -23.5. The bars are arranged in groups representing each specialty, where each group contains one orange bar and one light blue bar. The bars are not specifically sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
